_comment: Test user credentials for dynamic verification probes. Fill in per target application.
_format_notes: user_a = ATTACKER — their auth_header is sent with every probe request.
user_b = VICTIM  — their owned_object_ids supply the target object IDs.
owned_object_ids keys must match resource path segments in the target API.
Example: key 'orders' matches route path /orders/:orderId or /orders/{orderId}.
Sensitive tokens are used only at runtime and never committed to git.
